Name: Codex Keys
Description: Mac-only Codex Micro compatible controls for Stream Deck, with live task status and usage.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-1.Name: Agent 1 (Slot 1)
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-1.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 1 and brings Codex to the foreground.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-2.Name: Agent 2 (Slot 2)
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-2.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 2 and brings Codex to the foreground.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-3.Name: Agent 3 (Slot 3)
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-3.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 3 and brings Codex to the foreground.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-4.Name: Agent 4 (Slot 4)
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-4.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 4 and brings Codex to the foreground.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-5.Name: Agent 5 (Slot 5)
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-5.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 5 and brings Codex to the foreground.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-6.Name: Agent 6 (Slot 6)
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.agent-6.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 6 and brings Codex to the foreground.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-agent.Name: Dial · Agent selection
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-agent.Tooltip: Use the Stream Deck+ dial to move through Codex Micro agent candidates, then press or touch to bring the selected agent to the foreground. Touch-and-hold behavior can be configured.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-reason.Name: Dial · Reasoning level
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-reason.Tooltip: Adjust the Codex Micro reasoning level by rotating the Stream Deck+ dial. Press or touch to send an encoder click; long-touch behavior can be configured.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-conver.Name: Dial · Left/right control
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-conver.Tooltip: Sends the native left/right control configured in Codex Micro. Press or touch to send an encoder click; long-touch behavior can be configured.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.fast.Name: ACT06 · Physical key
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.fast.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT06 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.approve.Name: ACT07 · Physical key
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.approve.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT07 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.decline.Name: ACT08 · Physical key
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.decline.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT08 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.fork.Name: ACT09 · Physical key
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.fork.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT09 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dictation.Name: ACT10 · Physical key
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dictation.Tooltip: Sends key-down and key-up to physical position ACT10 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.act11.Name: ACT11 · Physical key
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.act11.Tooltip: Sends key-down and key-up to physical position ACT11 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.send.Name: ACT12 · Physical key
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.send.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT12 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.plan.Name: JOY_UP · Physical direction
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.plan.Tooltip: Sends physical direction JOY_UP in Codex Micro. The action follows the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.back.Name: JOY_LEFT · Physical direction
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.back.Tooltip: Sends physical direction JOY_LEFT in Codex Micro. The action follows the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.forward.Name: JOY_RIGHT · Physical direction
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.forward.Tooltip: Sends physical direction JOY_RIGHT in Codex Micro. The action follows the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.sidebar.Name: JOY_DOWN · Physical direction
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.sidebar.Tooltip: Sends physical direction JOY_DOWN in Codex Micro. The action follows the current assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.reasoning.Name: ENC_CLK · Physical press
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.reasoning.Tooltip: Sends physical position ENC_CLK in Codex Micro. The action follows the current encoder assignment in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.reasoning-d.Name: Action · Lower reasoning level
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.reasoning-d.Tooltip: Lowers the Codex Composer reasoning level by one step.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.reasoning-u.Name: Action · Raise reasoning level
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.reasoning-u.Tooltip: Raises the Codex Composer reasoning level by one step.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.new-task.Name: Action · New task
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.new-task.Tooltip: Opens a new task in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.usage-limit.Name: Usage · Remaining
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.usage-limit.Tooltip: Shows the remaining Codex usage. Five-hour and weekly views can be configured. The Codex action on press can be configured per key.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.usage-overv.Name: Usage · Five-hour / weekly
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.usage-overv.Tooltip: Shows five-hour and weekly Codex usage at the same time. The Codex action on press can be configured per key.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.rate-limit-.Name: Usage · Reset
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.rate-limit-.Tooltip: Shows available usage reset credits. Hold for 1.2 seconds when eligible to consume one credit.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-new-.Name: Keycap · New chat
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-new-.Tooltip: Opens a new chat in native Codex Micro.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-reas.Name: Keycap · Increase reasoning
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-reas.Tooltip: Increases the current Composer reasoning level.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-reas.Name: Keycap · Decrease reasoning
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-reas.Tooltip: Decreases the current Composer reasoning level.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-open.Name: Keycap · OpenAI docs
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-open.Tooltip: Opens the official OpenAI developer documentation.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-down.Name: Keycap · Copy chat as Markdown
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-down.Tooltip: Copies the current conversation as Markdown.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-pin.Name: Keycap · Pin chat
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-pin.Tooltip: Toggles pinning for the current chat.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-play.Name: Keycap · Run primary action
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-play.Tooltip: Runs the first configured environment action.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-git-.Name: Keycap · Commit or push
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-git-.Tooltip: Opens the native Codex Git commit action.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-bran.Name: Keycap · Create draft PR
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-bran.Tooltip: Opens the draft PR creation flow in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-merg.Name: Keycap · Merge PR
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-merg.Tooltip: Opens the PR merge flow in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-pull.Name: Keycap · Create PR
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-pull.Tooltip: Opens the native Codex PR creation flow.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-add-.Name: Keycap · Add photos
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-add-.Tooltip: Adds photos to the current Composer.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-add-.Name: Keycap · Attach files
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-add-.Tooltip: Attaches files or folders to the current Composer.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-mic.Name: Keycap · Push to talk (large)
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-mic.Tooltip: Starts Codex voice input while pressed.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-crea.Name: Keycap · Create branch
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.keycap-crea.Tooltip: Opens the branch creation flow in Codex.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-comman.Name: Dial · Select action
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-comman.Tooltip: Rotate to choose an action and press to run it.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-usage.Name: Dial · Usage
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-usage.Tooltip: Rotate to switch between five-hour and weekly remaining usage, then press to refresh.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-model.Name: Dial · Model
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.dial-model.Tooltip: Rotate to change the model. The current model is shown on the display.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.context-com.Name: Context compaction
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.context-com.Tooltip: Shows observed context usage for the current Codex task and requests native compaction on press.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.side-to-mai.Name: Move side input to main
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.side-to-mai.Tooltip: Moves unsent side-chat text into an empty main input field without sending it.

io.local.codexdeck.microplus.global-dict.Name: Voice input · Shortcut PTT
io.local.codexdeck.microplus.global-dict.Tooltip: Records the shortcut used to toggle recording in settings. Sends once on press and once on release. Use while recording is stopped.
